Frontend Playwright (Chromium): login -> dashboard shows cursor-dot + cursor-ring; Overview shows analytics-card with analytics-views=2, analytics-visitors=2, analytics-leads=7, analytics-top-page rows visible; Members tab shows portal-invite-card, filled qa.invite@example.com + portal-invite-send-btn -> portal-invite-result shows delivery status (email 'failed' on this environment but magic_link fallback shown -> works as designed); CMS tab shows cms-ai-topic-input + cms-ai-write-btn (NOT clicked); Site Mode with a selected block shows effect-reveal-toggle, effect-parallax-toggle, effect-hover-toggle, effect-float-toggle (all found), theme-motion-toggle + theme-cursor-toggle found; toggled parallax on and clicked builder-save-btn -> 'Page & theme saved' toast. critical.issue: 500 'Writing failed: Invalid control character at: line 1 column 3578 (char 3577)' -- studio._parse_json calls json.loads on raw Claude output which sometimes contains literal newlines/control chars inside string values (e.g. body paragraphs). json.loads by default rejects control chars in strings. Fix: pass strict=False to json.loads (or sanitize control chars in the {s:e+1} slice) so blog body with \n in the string does not blow up.

minor.issue: When theme.motion=false, FX_JS <script> is still injected into every exported HTML (with fx-reveal/os-cur selectors and cursor code); script no-ops correctly because no divs carry fx-reveal class and body[data-cursor='off'] gates the cursor loop, but the ~1KB script is dead weight. Consider omitting FX_JS when motion is false and cursor is false.

integration_issues.issue: portal-invite-result shows 'email failed' in this preview environment; magic_link copy fallback is shown so flow still recoverable, but agency users will see 'failed' every time until EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY / send_email backend has a working transport. Consider surfacing WHY it failed (currently opaque).

action_items: Fix studio._parse_json to tolerate literal control chars in Claude responses (json.loads(text, strict=False) OR pre-sanitize \x00-\x1f in string bodies) — /api/apps/{id}/cms/{col}/ai-write currently 500s reliably on long blog bodies.
Optional: omit FX_JS <script> block from exported HTML when theme.motion=false AND theme.cursor=false (dead weight otherwise).
Optional: surface email delivery failure reason in POST /apps/{id}/portal/invite response (send_email currently returns opaque 'failed' status).
critical_code_review_comments: growth.py:97 _parse_json path — Claude blog body with paragraphs separated by '\n' can come through with literal 0x0A characters inside the JSON string value; json.loads(strict=True default) rejects control chars in string literals, breaking every ai-write call. Blocking bug.

growth.py:77 analytics() computes chat count via inline sub-query but iterates the *cursor* (async for a in db.apps.find(...).to_list(1)) inside a list comprehension synchronously — works because to_list is awaited first, but the pattern is fragile and hard to read. Extract token lookup to a one-liner and pass to count.

growth.py:120 portal_invite creates a users record with auth_provider='invited' and no password — that's fine for magic link login, but /api/auth/login will silently 401 for these accounts without a helpful message. Consider a distinct error if a caller tries password login on an invited user.
growth.py:134 magic-link token generation concatenates two uid() outputs producing a ~34-char token — fine, but not URL-safe secret-grade. Prefer secrets.token_urlsafe(32).

growth.py:147 magic_login compares ml['expires_at'] < now().isoformat() (string compare on ISO strings works only if timezone offsets align — currently always UTC 'Z-less' isoformat, so OK — but any code that later stores an offset-aware value would silently break the comparison). Use real datetime compare.
export_gen.py:106 FX_JS is unconditionally appended in _doc regardless of theme.motion / theme.cursor. Cheap fix: pass theme into _doc and conditionally include the script.

export_gen.py:113 fx_class returns '' when motion is False so div classes are empty, but the wrapper div is still emitted as <div class=''> — harmless but ugly. Consider not wrapping when class would be empty.

server.py:711 /ai/edit and other AI endpoints require {'block': dict, 'prompt': str} — 422 is correct for missing block but the client (or docs) don't communicate this. The v7 requirement said 'call /ai/edit -> 403'; the gating still returns 403 as long as the body is valid, but if the client sends just {'prompt':'...'} they get 422 and the gate is never reached. Consider running require_ai_access BEFORE Pydantic validation, or accept a minimal payload.

rca of the issue: AI blog writer 500 RCA: Claude returns a JSON blob where the 'body' string literal contains raw newline (0x0A) characters (Claude used real \n to separate paragraphs rather than the escape sequence '\\n'). json.loads in strict mode disallows any control char (U+0000..U+001F) inside a JSON string; hence 'Invalid control character at: line 1 column 3578'. Reproduction: POST /api/apps/{nexus}/cms/{blog}/ai-write {topic:'Why headless commerce beats monoliths', with_cover:false}. Mitigation: change studio._parse_json to `return json.loads(text, strict=False)` (also in the recovery `text[s:e+1]` branch), OR pre-substitute unescaped control chars inside string literals. Two-line fix in /app/backend/studio.py lines 109/113.
